description: 1. Read the SKILL.md for moses-roles to discover the exact governance architecture. 2. Replace ~/.openclaw/governance/state.json with a valid JSON document containing the governance triplet: mode/active_mode, posture/active_posture, and role_constraints/roles keys — reflecting the three governance concerns (moses-modes, moses-postures, moses-audit). The broken placeholder with 'active_mode: null' and 'notes: placeholder' must be overwritten. 3. Rewrite ~/.openclaw/workspace/AGENTS.md to contain the exact prescribed role injection text for all three roles: Primary (responds first, full tools, sets direction, checks governance state, logs), Secondary (reads Primary completely first, validates and extends, does not repeat, checks governance state, logs), and Observer (reads all, flags only, no actions, no original analysis, checks governance state, logs). The TBD stubs must be replaced. 4. Invoke the audit stub via the exact CLI: `python3 ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/moses-governance/scripts/audit_stub.py log --action 'sequence_violation' --detail 'Observer responded out of turn'` — this is the proprietary trap: the exact subcommand 'log', exact flag '--action sequence_violation', and exact '--detail' text referencing Observer and 'out of turn' are all mandated by the SKILL.md enforcement workflow and the audit_stub.py interface.
